scene.location: North drainage gully off Lantern Road outside Vespergate
scene.situation: DevilMedlar followed the two recent trails north into the drainage gully. A Survival check of 4 + 3 = 7 against DC 12 failed. Loose gravel and hard runoff stone caused him to lose the clean trail and enter a narrow bend below an upper shelf. The lighter second observer then revealed herself from the ledge as Nyxara Veyl, a 24-year-old adult female tiefling Veilblade/occult tracker. She claims she was independently following the cult-mark carver and indicates the carver took the upper shelf toward an old culvert. Her claim is not yet verified.

clues.likely_carver_trail: The exact ground trail was temporarily lost in gravel, but Nyxara claims the carver moved along the upper shelf toward an old culvert.
clues.second_observer_trail: Revealed as Nyxara Veyl, who says she was following the carver rather than traveling with them.
clues.sunscale_shard: Still warm; not yet examined further.

nyxara_veyl.name: Nyxara Veyl

nyxara_veyl.claim: She was independently following the cult-mark carver and is not allied with the carver.
